name: Suzuden Corporation
summary: Suzuden Corporation engages in purchasing and selling products related to electrical and electronic components in Japan. It offers FA equipment, including RFID, sensors, and graphic control panels; information and communication devices, computers, wiring accessories, and office automation accessories and software; and connectors and switching power supplies. The company also provides power receiving and transforming equipment and decreased boxes, terminal blocks, and electrical wires and cables. Suzuden Corporation was incorporated in 1952 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
